summary: Kazia Therapeutics Limited furnished a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, disclosing two press releases about preclinical data for its lead drug paxalisib in MSS/pMMR colorectal cancer and expansion of a clinical trial to HR+/HER2- breast cancer. The filing contains no corporate transaction, capital action, or structural event. It is an ordinary operational update on scientific progress, with no mention of deal terms, advisors, or recommendations. No special-situation category applies; regulatory filings of this nature constitute routine current reports.
